# ai_dotfiles — onboarding

## 1. Goal

**What:** The single source of the owner's global AI-CLI setup on macOS: one rules file, per-CLI settings keys, shared MCP servers, pinned plugins, 38 skill folders (one, `git/`, a bundle of 8) and two hooked skills (worktree-guard, small-commits), applied to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi and Antigravity so every CLI behaves the same way in every project. It also carries the owner's git flow (a worktree per task, `ship`, `approve`), a shared status line and a nightly daily-log pass.

**How:** `config/ai-clis.json` says which CLIs are on and where each reads things. `ai-dotfiles install` runs seven Python steps: link what is read-only (the rules file, every skill, the commands, Pi's extension), merge what a CLI writes back (settings keys, hook entries), add MCP servers and plugins through each CLI's own commands, and load a 04:00 LaunchAgent. Every write is validated, backed up, atomic and rolled back on failure. Hooks go through one adapter, `scripts/agent_hooks.py` (Pi: `agent_hooks.ts`). `ai-dotfiles check` compares live state with the repo; CI runs the unittest suites and shellcheck on every push; a weekly Action mirrors the CLIs' docs into `docs/upstream/` and opens a PR.

## 2. System design

**Shape:** one monolith of scripts and config, no frontend or API: a global command (`ai-dotfiles`), a second command (`daily-log`), hook scripts behind one adapter, a Pi extension, a LaunchAgent and two GitHub Actions workflows.

### Tech stack

| Layer | Technology | Version | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| Language | Python, standard library only | 3.11+; CI 3.12 | `scripts/install.sh:25`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:35` |
| Language | Bash | — | `scripts/*.sh`, `scripts/ai-dotfiles` |
| Language | TypeScript, one file, no build (Pi's extension) | — | `scripts/agent_hooks.ts` |
| Config | JSON for desired state, Markdown for rules and skills | — | `config/`, `skills/` |
| Tests | unittest, against a temporary `HOME` and real temporary repos | — | `scripts/tests/`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:38` |
| Lint | shellcheck (warning level); pyright paths | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml:23`, `pyrightconfig.json` |
| CI | GitHub Actions: tests on push; Monday docs sync | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml` |
| Scheduling | launchd LaunchAgent, 04:00 daily | — | `scripts/install/launchd.py:41` |
| Git hosting | `gh` CLI, a second reviewer login per repo | — | `skills/git/scripts/git_run.py:73` |
| Targets | Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, Antigravity | — | `config/ai-clis.json` |

### Folder structure

```text
ai_dotfiles/
├── AGENTS.md                 ★ maintainer rules and the verify commands
├── config/
│   ├── ai-clis.json          ★ which CLIs are on, where each reads
│   ├── global-agents.md      the one global rule file, linked into every CLI
│   ├── cli-settings.json     per-CLI settings: enforce and default keys
│   ├── mcp-servers.json      shared MCP servers
│   ├── plugins.json          plugins: GitHub source, pinned version, CLIs
│   └── upstream-docs.json    the docs sources mirrored weekly
├── skills/                   38 skill folders, linked into every CLI
│   ├── which-skill/          ★ the router: which skill fits which situation
│   ├── worktree-guard/       hook + `ai-dotfiles worktree` commands
│   ├── small-commits/        hook + `ai-dotfiles commit check`
│   ├── git/                  bundle: push, pr, review, tag, merge, prune,
│   │                         approve, ship; scripts/git_run.py shared
│   ├── daily-log/            journal grammar, `daily-log`, day_pass.py
│   └── skills.lock           upstream pins and local edits
├── scripts/
│   ├── ai-dotfiles           ★ the global command; dispatches to the rest
│   ├── agent_hooks.py        ★ every CLI's hook format behind one Event
│   ├── agent_hooks.ts        Pi's extension for the same hooks
│   ├── agent_sessions.py     every CLI's transcripts, for the day pass
│   ├── statusline.py         the status line Claude Code and Antigravity run
│   ├── install.sh            the seven steps; uninstall.sh, healthcheck.sh
│   ├── install/              one module per step; installer.py writes safely
│   ├── upstream/             the weekly docs mirror and its PR report
│   └── tests/                unittest suites, one per script
├── docs/
│   ├── how-it-works.md       ★ the mechanism, glossary, each CLI's paths
│   ├── plans/                design in progress (worktree convention)
│   ├── agents/               issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs
│   └── upstream/             machine-written docs mirror; never hand-edit
└── .github/workflows/        ci.yml; sync-cli-docs.yml
```

### Layers

```text
┌─ GitHub ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Actions runners, the API, PRs                                        │

└──────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
           │ checkouts, pushes, PRs, reviews, tags (gh, git)
┌─ repo ───┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ this checkout: desired state and the scripts that apply it           │
│ config/    CLIs, rules, settings, MCP, plugins, doc sources          │
│ skills/    38 skills; hooks in worktree-guard/, small-commits/       │
│ scripts/   ai-dotfiles, install/ (7 steps), agent_hooks, statusline  │
└──────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
           │ links, merged keys and hook entries, mcp/plugin add, plist
┌─ home ───┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ where every CLI reads its global files                               │
│ ~/.claude ~/.codex ~/.agents ~/.pi ~/.gemini   rules, skills, hooks  │
│ ~/.local/bin/        ai-dotfiles, daily-log, plugin commands (links) │
│ ~/.local/state/ai-dotfiles/   receipts, backups, hook state          │
│ ~/Library/LaunchAgents/       the 04:00 day pass                     │
└──────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
           │ read at start-up; hooks fire around tools and at session end
┌─ CLIs ───┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ the claude, codex, pi and antigravity processes                      │
│ skills, plugins, MCP servers   loaded from home                      │
│ PreToolUse, SessionEnd, …      run a hook script; Pi: the extension  │
│ status line                    `ai-dotfiles statusline` per refresh  │
└──────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
           │ edits in the open repo; transcripts; `daily-log add`
┌─ outside ┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ the repo a session works in, and the journal                         │
│ <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<type>-<slug>   one worktree per task       │
│ ~/Documents/Claude/Projects/daily-logger  the journal                │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Workflows

#### install — `ai-dotfiles install` (and `update`, `check`)

```text
desired state ──▶ installer ──▶ global files
                      ├──▶ MCP + plugins ──▶ receipt
                      ├──▶ hook files
                      └──▶ LaunchAgent
ai-dotfiles check ──▶ healthcheck ──▶ dry-run install (expect 0 changes)
```

- desired state (repo): CLIs on, their paths, every list — `config/ai-clis.json`, `scripts/install/installer.py`
- installer (repo): checks the config, then the seven steps in order; `update` fast-forwards `main` first; run from a worktree, every link still points at the main checkout — `scripts/install.sh:55`, `:90`, `scripts/install/installer.py:67`
- global files (home): rules file, skill folders and commands linked; settings keys merged — `scripts/install/instructions.py`, `scripts/install/skills.py`, `scripts/install/settings.py`
- MCP + plugins (CLIs): `<cli> mcp add` when missing; each plugin at its release tag through the CLI's own manager, dependencies checked, read back — `scripts/install/mcp.py`, `scripts/install/plugins.py:702`
- receipt (home): what the step installed vs. took over; uninstall leaves plugins in place — `scripts/install/plugins.py:706`
- hook files (home): one entry per event for worktree-guard and small-commits; the old daily-log nudge taken out — `scripts/install/hooks.py:66`, `:71`, `:51`
- LaunchAgent (home): plist running `daily-log day --write` at 04:00 — `scripts/install/launchd.py:46`, `:77`
- healthcheck (repo): dry-run install, `mcp list`, machine-path scan, tests; from a worktree, live state is measured against the main checkout — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:20`

#### task — first edit in a repo with the flow on, to `ship`

```text
edit call ──▶ agent_hooks ──▶ guard route ──main checkout──▶ "name this work"
                                   │
worktree new ──▶ worktree ──▶ claim ──▶ commits ──▶ ship
                                                     ├──▶ checks
                                                     ├──▶ branch + PR
                                                     └──▶ worktree deleted
```

- edit call (CLIs): `PreToolUse` on edits and shell; Pi's `tool_call` — `scripts/agent_hooks.ts`
- agent_hooks (repo): CLI JSON in as an `Event`, reply out in that CLI's shape, fails open — `scripts/agent_hooks.py:238`
- guard route (repo): only repos with `worktree-guard.flow true`; the main checkout is refused, another session's worktree is refused — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:672`, `:211`
- worktree new (repo): fetches origin, makes `.claude/worktrees/<type>-<slug>` detached, no local branch; `worktree pr <n>` does the same on an open PR — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:1096`, `:1158`
- claim (home): first edit owns the worktree under a file lock; session end frees it and sweeps leftovers — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:496`, `:898`
- commits (repo): gated by small-commits (300 warn, 600 wall, trailers) — `skills/small-commits/scripts/small_commits.py:394`
- ship (repo): runs AGENTS.md's Verify block, pushes `<type>/<slug>` (or onto the PR's branch), opens or updates the PR, deletes the worktree — `skills/git/ship/scripts/ship.py:151`, `:55`, `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:936`

#### approve — the person says `approve <n>`

```text
approve ──▶ reviewer ──▶ review ──▶ tag ──▶ merge ──▶ branch ──▶ main
                                                                 └──▶ worktree
```

- approve (repo): `approve <n>` lands PR n from any session; bare `approve` adds preflight, push, PR and prune for the branch checked out — `skills/git/approve/scripts/approve.py:91`, `:110`
- reviewer (GitHub): a second login, cached per repo in `git config approve.reviewer` — `skills/git/approve-pr/scripts/approve_pr.py:53`
- review (GitHub): approves the PR as that login — `skills/git/approve-pr/scripts/approve_pr.py:65`
- tag (GitHub): `archive/<name>` at the PR's head, pushed before the merge — `skills/git/archive-tag/scripts/archive_tag.py:69`
- merge (GitHub): a merge commit — `skills/git/merge-pr/scripts/merge_pr.py:24`
- branch (GitHub): the PR's branch deleted on origin — `skills/git/prune-branch/scripts/prune_branch.py:44`
- main (outside): the main checkout fast-forwarded, only when git can without touching uncommitted files — `skills/git/prune-branch/scripts/prune_branch.py:70`
- worktree (outside): run in the work's own worktree, its local branch goes, then the worktree, last, through worktree-guard; only the tag is left — `skills/git/prune-branch/scripts/prune_branch.py:169`, `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:969`

#### day pass — LaunchAgent at 04:00

```text
launchd ──▶ day pass ──▶ sessions ──▶ evidence ──▶ claude -p ──▶ journal
```

- launchd (home): runs `~/.local/bin/daily-log day --write` — `scripts/install/launchd.py:46`
- day pass (repo): yesterday plus the days before, cut at 04:00 — `skills/daily-log/scripts/day_pass.py:200`
- sessions (home): every CLI's transcripts in the window, scratch folders dropped — `scripts/agent_sessions.py:83`
- evidence (repo): per day, sessions and repo facts, existing entries — `skills/daily-log/scripts/day_pass.py:161`
- claude -p (CLIs): one Sonnet session allowed only `daily-log add` — `skills/daily-log/scripts/day_pass.py:54`, `:190`
- journal (outside): one entry per project per day — `skills/daily-log/LOG-FORMAT.md`

## 3. Conventions

- Files: Python modules and tests in snake_case, one `test_<script>.py` per script; shell scripts and config in kebab-case; each skill a folder with `SKILL.md`, its code in `skills/<name>/scripts/`.
- Code: direct imports by path, no injection; hook scripts supply `decide(event, state)` to `agent_hooks`; install steps plan `(path, before, after)` changes, `installer.show`, then `installer.apply`; git steps share `git_run` (`step`, `act` with `dry`, `Stop`). Subprocesses run synchronously.
- Errors: shell under `set -euo pipefail` (`scripts/install.sh:28`); install steps raise `ValueError` naming the path; git steps raise `Stop` with the next action, and a cleanup they cannot do safely is a `skipped:` line instead. Hooks fail open: exit 0, never stderr.
- Tests: load each script by path, temporary `HOME` and state folder (`scripts/tests/support.py`); guard and git tests use real temporary repos with a bare origin.
- Git: conventional subjects with a scope (`fix(ship): …`), under 300 lines a commit, with Why:/Scope:/Verified: trailers; one worktree per task, pushed as `<type>/<slug>` by `ship`; PRs merged by merge commit after a second-login approval. A landing leaves only an `archive/<name>` tag (27 so far): branch and worktree deleted. `main` plus `upstream-sync`, force-pushed weekly.

## 4. Common tasks

- Test: `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests`
- Lint: `shellcheck scripts/*.sh scripts/ai-dotfiles`
- Preview an install: `bash scripts/install.sh --dry-run` (zero changes on a configured Mac)
- Check live state: `bash scripts/healthcheck.sh`, or `ai-dotfiles check`
- Install, update, uninstall: `ai-dotfiles install`, `ai-dotfiles update`, `ai-dotfiles uninstall`
- One step: `python3 scripts/install/<step>.py --dry-run`, `--uninstall`, `--target <cli>`
- Start a task: `ai-dotfiles worktree new <type>/<slug>`; fix a PR: `ai-dotfiles worktree pr <n>`; see them: `ai-dotfiles worktree list`
- Finish: `ai-dotfiles ship --title "…" --body-file <file>`; land: `ai-dotfiles approve <n>`
- Day pass by hand: `daily-log day` (evidence only), `daily-log day --write`
